kind: Read-only a300 fresh-import storage compatibility review; prospective acquisition prerequisite

sources.proposedProductProvenance: Root-reported exact eight-file child of a300; this source-only review does not claim a fresh build or correctness pass.

findings.conclusion: A fresh database begins on the legacy epoch-0 content path. New version-2 import arenas are conditional on an already activated committed root; their existence is not an unconditional consequence of #982.

evidence.detail: Open recovers any journal, then activates committed addressing only if stored epoch>0; otherwise prepares the legacy store.
Schema adds metadata; seeding writes legacy-root-v0 with activeEpoch0 and a legacy manifest.
A version2 checkpoint with no committed root throws; arena namespace/file creation is inside committedRoot!==null.
createImportCheckpoint returns version2 only for a committed root; the fresh route snapshots legacy segments.
The arena fixtures explicitly activate storageEpoch1 or7 before expecting an arena or version2 checkpoint.
The additive-schema test expects legacy-root-v0/activeEpoch0 after initialization.

findings.conclusion: The source still installs and reserves a minimum of eight SAH files. This supports retaining the existing eight-file structural requirement; it is not proof that every observed inventory has exactly eight files or seven idle4096B files.

evidence.detail: OPFS_SAHPOOL_MIN_CAPACITY=8.
installOpfsSAHPoolVfs receives initialCapacity8; reserveMinimumCapacity8 follows; actual capacity/fileCount are diagnostics.

findings.conclusion: Historical VNDB active SAH allocation37/37 cannot be asserted from a300 source. Initialization always creates eight new metadata tables, their keys/indexes and two seeded rows; optimizer discovery may also persist job metadata. Source alone does not determine SQLite page reuse, free-list use, final byte size, or cross-observation equality.

evidence.detail: Unconditional CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statements, primary/unique keys, explicit idx_term_content_single_active_job and legacy seeding.
Six storage tables plus two optimization tables and legacy state asserted.
Eight SAH files/seven4096B files, one aligned active file and explicit VNDB unit range are validated; canonical bytes remain exact for every comparison.

findings.conclusion: The optional optimizer is not disabled by default. It starts only after admission/ownership release and a10000ms idle deadline, and visible foreground requests preempt it. Raw/preset-JMdict selectors are skipped before activation, while a shared raw-v4 artifact is inspected independently and can be eligible. Thus known raw-block-v2:jmdict/raw-v6 layouts do not alone prove absence of every possible eligible artifact on an unseen fresh a300 run.

evidence.detail: Default idleMs10000, continuationMs1, retryMs30000.
Wake schedules only after no foreground/holds.
Foreground admission synchronously preempts; last release resets the idle deadline.
Production worker installs the scheduler with default options and initial backend-startup hold.
Backend refresh/UI completion holds remain; diagnostic/status polling does not preempt optional maintenance.
Raw selectors and getLegacyTermContentZstdCodecId(blockCodec??selector) are skipped.
The preset jmdict codec returns a non-null known codec ID.
Shared artifact handling is separate; raw-v4 artifact payloads are inspected even though raw references skip.
Activation requires a successful eligible-frame proof; a complete skip scan persists no-gain without activation.
Discovery scans record references with skipSelector and then queries sharedGlossaryArtifacts separately.
Tests raw-block-v2:jmdict skip, generic compressed eligibility, dictionary-bearing skip, and separate shared artifact extent.
Matched-generation no-op test asserts activation is never called, while durable job metadata is retained.

findings.conclusion: The frozen observer inventories complete logical OPFS sizes after browser restart, lookup verification and media validation. It adds no optimizer hold and establishes no less-than10000ms upper bound for these steps. Future baseline observations must demonstrate that the fixed known-path/eight-SAH contract and exact bytes still apply; this review does not infer it from earlier f28/dcfc runs.

evidence.detail: Relaunch, settings readiness, dictionary counts, lookup/readability checks, media verification, then recursive OPFS listing.
Every observation is canonicalized and must match the first canonical receipt; no allocation allowance is removed from the exact comparison.

prospectivePrerequisite.status: Root accepted this prerequisite before any fresh a300 full cohort acquisition.
prospectivePrerequisite.after: Fresh exact a300/61ac correctness and native reproduction gates.
prospectivePrerequisite.observations: Exactly one separately identified excluded baseline storage observation for each locked dictionary; fresh profile, production defaults, pinned fixtures/browser and unchanged observer/verification boundary.
prospectivePrerequisite.retainedEvidence: Retain complete raw reports, full OPFS file inventories/sizes, source/package/browser identities, original logs and any failed observation. Every emitted duration is excluded from candidate comparisons and performance claims.
prospectivePrerequisite.admission: Keep the existing known product path set and eight-SAH/seven4096B-file structural checks. Inspect the observed aligned active allocation and record a new exact VNDB bound prospectively before the separately launched252 plan.
prospectivePrerequisite.mismatch: If any structural mismatch occurs, hold for a source-grounded review and a separately recorded prospective decision. Do not broaden paths, normalize away bytes, disable maintenance, alter cache/workers/flags/memory limits, choose favorable measurements, or silently relax an old bound.
prospectivePrerequisite.downstream: No automatic252 launch. Full latency/non-target/memory/storage gates remain unchanged; all actual canonical bytes must match across observations.
